origin.description: Radius 0.1 keeps the two codes apart. The initial codes are supplied.
origin.details: Radius 0.1 keeps the two codes apart. The initial codes are supplied.
origin.example:
cat(data <- matrix(c(0,0, 0.05,0, 10,0, 10.1,0), ncol=2, byrow=TRUE)
  init <- matrix(c(0,0, 10,0), ncol=2, byrow=TRUE)
  as.numeric(batchSOM(data, somgrid(2, 1), radii=0.1, init=init)$codes), "\n")
